messages:
alex_sales: Heads up — Acme asked for a clean one-pager for their on-prem POC: USB (sneakernet) delivery, bundle signing options, SBOM delivery, hotfix SLA (24h?), and whether we bill on handoff or on apply. Need SOW sentence + ops checklist they can sign.
priya_se: We support two flows: (1) Redwood HSM-signed detached signatures + root import; (2) Customer escrow key (we produce a signed bundle template they sign locally). Option 2 requires a liability waiver.
omar_sre: Ops notes: recommend multi-signature manifests for extra assurance (redwood_sig + customer_sig). Chunk large model content (parts <= 40GB), include per-part SHA256 in manifest, and ship a resumable apply utility with integrity checks.
priya_se: Example verification we put in runbook:
```
# verify manifest checksums and both signatures
sha256sum -c redwood.manifest && openssl dgst -sha256 -verify redwood_pub.pem -signature redwood.sig bundle.part1
openssl dgst -sha256 -verify customer_pub.pem -signature customer.sig bundle.part1
# dry-run apply and emit receipt
./redwood-apply --bundle parts/ --verify --dry-run --emit-receipt > apply.receipt
```
alex_sales: They explicitly asked: if we can commit to a signed hotfix in 24h and same-day handoff to courier. What's realistic?
omar_sre: Signed artifact within 24h on enterprise SLA + expedited fee is doable. Same-day courier pickup depends on customer logistics; include chain-of-custody checklist and tamper-evident packaging steps. We won't accept responsibility for transit delays.
lucy_legal: Contract bullets: "Expedited Signed Artifact" available within 24 hours for Enterprise Support tier subject to expedited-fee schedule and customer confirmation of pickup. Redwood provides signed artifacts and chain-of-custody documentation; customer is responsible for physical transport. Include export control/crypto disclosure.
priya_se: Billing: recommend bundle-issuance fee per major release + optional per-site offline maintenance (covers N deltas/month). If Acme wants billing on "applied", we require an offline receipt flow: redwood-apply uploads a signed receipt or prints a signed token customer scans and later uploads. Without receipt we bill on delivery.
alex_sales: Can we add exact SOW phrasing for "offline bundle verification" and "rollback path"? They need wording they can paste.
omar_sre: Proposed SOW lines (short): "Redwood will deliver signed bundle artifacts (detached signatures and SBOM). Customer will verify checksums and signatures prior to apply. Redwood will provide rollback tooling to revert to the pre-apply snapshot; rollback steps are documented in the runbook."
priya_se: Add a short acceptance item: "Post-apply acceptance window: 72 hours. If customer reports a functional failure during acceptance, Redwood will provide one remediation delta free of charge and assist with rollback."
lucy_legal: Also include: "Customer may choose Customer-Sign Kit; choosing this option transfers signing responsibility to Customer and requires execution of the Signing Kit Addendum."
priya_se: Technical caveat to call out: if a patch changes model quantization or file layout, KV cache migration may be required and apply time increases. Recommend labeling deltas that are model-compatibility vs data-only.
omar_sre: Runbook checklist I'll drop here (short): pre-apply: verify manifest & signatures; create pre-apply snapshot; dry-run apply; apply; smoke tests; emit signed apply.receipt; store receipt and optionally upload. Rollback: runredwood-rollback --token <snapshot>.
ops-bot: ops-bot: created SALES-9321 (deliverables: 1-page ops checklist, SOW snippets for HSM vs Customer-Sign, expedited-fee table, offline receipt workflow).
alex_sales: Please post the one-pager + SOW snippets in this thread by EOD. I need to send to Acme. :pray:
priya_se: I'll post a 1-page ops checklist (commands + timing estimates) in ~90m.
lucy_legal: I'll post contract snippet + expedited-fee wording by EOD.
omar_sre: I'll add packaging guidance + chunking recommendations and compressed delta strategy (rsync-friendly chunks) in ~2h.
alex_sales: Thanks team — if we can get all drafts here I'll consolidate and push to the customer today. :thumbsup:
